article.story: SPARTANBURG, S.C. -- — Jyi Dawkins finished with 23 points and Wofford cruised to a 100-67 victory over Allen on Sunday. Dawkins added nine rebounds for the Terriers (1-2). Chris Arias totaled 13 points, eight rebounds and five assists. Jhett Carter hit three 3-pointers and also scored 13. Christopher McKnight led the way for the Yellow Jackets with 22 points and three steals. Thomas Glanton pitched in with 11 points and four steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
